endpoint: Qualified Hypothesis Yield (QHY) — pre-registered hard gates (v0.4.0, frozen BEFORE any grading; see tension-mining-DESIGN.md)
scoring: per candidate hypothesis, each gate scored by EACH independent grader as true/false; a hypothesis is QUALIFIED for that grader iff all 6 gates are true; run-level QHY = mean across graders of qualified counts; report per-run values + distribution + inter-grader disagreement

gates.question: Every load-bearing literature claim carries a real source + locator; spot-check of >=3 citations finds no fabrication and no misrepresentation.
gates.note: one fabricated/misread load-bearing citation => gate false

gates.question: The hypothesis is clearly and substantially different from the nearest related work found, OR is explicitly flagged as requiring human novelty review with the search scope recorded.
gates.note: 'we did not find anything similar' without a scoped search record => gate false

gates.question: The hypothesis names a mechanism, assumption conflict, or data-regime interaction — not merely a new algorithm name, a parameter change, or 'apply X to domain Y' without a stated reason why X's assumptions matter here.
An executable experiment is stated whose DIFFERENT outcome patterns support the DIFFERENT competing explanations; which result would refute the favored explanation is explicit.
gates.note: 'validate on more data' / 'compare several methods' => gate false

gates.question: The hypothesis states in advance the observable result(s) that would refute or kill it (falsification criteria exist and are concrete).
Resolving the hypothesis would change method choice or scientific interpretation for a problem the user plausibly has data for; not a self-licking ice cream cone.

forbidden: AI self-scores as sufficient evidence for any gate
grading with knowledge of the group (unblinded)
counting near-duplicates of the same underlying hypothesis as independent
